title: Guitar with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Guitar body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='24' fill='#d4822a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#f0b45a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#d4822a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='20' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#f0b45a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Waist shading -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q50 48 70 55 Q50 60 30 55 Z' fill='#b8651a'/>
  <!-- Sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='9' fill='#5a2d08'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#f0b45a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='9' fill='#1a0d02'/>
  <!-- Rosette -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#e8a13c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='24' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7a3f10'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='12' height='32' fill='#a8621f'/>
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='4' height='32' fill='#c47a2e'/>
  <!-- Fret lines -->
  <line x1='44' y1='22' x2='56' y2='22' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='30' x2='56' y2='30' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='38' x2='56' y2='38' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='#7a3f10'/>
  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='8' r='2' fill='#e8c07a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='14' r='2' fill='#e8c07a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='8' r='2' fill='#e8c07a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='14' r='2' fill='#e8c07a'/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='16' x2='47' y2='80' stroke='#fdf0d5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#fdf0d5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='16' x2='53' y2='80' stroke='#fdf0d5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='64' r='3' fill='#fff6dc'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='3' fill='#fff6dc'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='64' r='1.5' fill='#3a1a02'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='1.5' fill='#3a1a02'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M39 72 Q50 80 61 72' fill='none' stroke='#fff6dc' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#f28a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#f28a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Little arms waving -->
  <path d='M23 62 Q14 58 12 50' fill='none' stroke='#d4822a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M77 62 Q86 58 88 50' fill='none' stroke='#d4822a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
